_comment: Recipe: AB-MCTS-A (adaptive branching MCTS, Sakana AI arXiv:2503.04412 / SakanaAI/treequest) as a gama backend over local Mac Studio MLX models. At each node the search Thompson-samples GO WIDER (fresh candidate) vs GO DEEPER (refine an existing one) with the case checker as the reward, and picks WHICH model per widen step (Multi-LLM AB-MCTS). Replace ssh_host with your Mac's SSH host (user@host). Reproduce with: gama bench --suite hard --backends abmcts,ensemble,ssh-openai --config recipes/mac-studio-abmcts/config.json --tier large. The `ensemble` here is the HONEST CONTROL = width-only best-of-N of the same two workers (strategy=first, no aggregator LLM), so you can see whether the ADAPTIVE search beats plain repeated sampling at equal-ish budget, not just whether search beats one model. `seed` is null so bench --repeats gets real variance; set an int for a reproducible single run.
